newsitem.title: USA: Mid Atlantic Medical faces class action.
newsitem.headline: Mid Atlantic Medical faces class action.

text.p: A class action lawsuit was filed Tuesday on behalf of those who bought common stock of Mid Atlantic Medical Services Inc between February 29 and August 14, lawyers for the plaintiffs said.
The suit was filed in the Circuit Court for Montgomery County, Maryland.

The complaint charges the company and Chief Executive George Jochum with misrepresenting and omitting information concerning the company's revenues, costs and margins during the class period, said a statement from plaintiff's lawyers at the firm of Milberg Weiss Bershad Hynes & Lerach.
Joseph Guarriello, general counsel for Mid Atlantic Medical Services Inc, was not immediately available for comment.
During the class period, the lawyers say, the company's medical loss ratio increased to 96.1 percent.
Before such disclosures were made, the complaint alleges, Jochum sold hundreds of thousands of shares of the company's common stock beneficially owned by him for proceeds in excess of $2.9 million.
